cumulative_usage.scope: Previous completed pilot plus every native attempt in this iteration. Current iteration limits apply only to its own ledger.

token_cap_compliance: Unknown usage prevents establishing the full native-token total; only the known lower bound is available.
author_exposure_limitation_preserved_in_: Initial platform-injected MEMORY_SUMMARY exposed general historical project context and aggregate prior evaluation summaries. Subsequent reads were limited to pinned generic contracts/schemas, own authored files, authorized independent sealed reviews, and contents-free actual-freeze/public-gate metadata. No new public answers, grades or raw public summary were read. Actual freeze exposes only product filenames and hashes, not product source. No product/runtime/helper/protocol source, prior private datasets, user Store, retrieval algorithms, network or native/model calls. Procedural independence is not a security proof.

operator_offline_export_deviation.scope: Operator-authorized unchanged helper export calls aggregate offline; this is evidence preservation after driver refused further model phases.

limits: Failed call usage and actual native profile are unavailable, not zero or independently established.
Hypothetical API scenarios cover reported known usage only and exclude the failed call’s unknown usage; they are not complete total costs or actual billing.
Partial grades are descriptive observations under full denominators, not a completed quality outcome.
Mechanical identity/schema/recount only; no new model judgments, grade repair, reruns, Store mutation, source edits or network.
Incomplete slots and failed calls remain explicit; integrity success never asserts quality success.
Disclosed controls and post-sealing exposure limitations remain attached; actual billing is unknown.
